scope: Desktop VS Code with a throwaway profile and extensions directory, a disposable workspace and Git repository, and a fixture provider running real child processes. No personal profile and no provider account.
method: Commands run from the application's own palette and real mouse presses on its own controls, driven by scripts/cdp.mjs. Assertions are made against the durable records, not the UI.
limitation: The desktop build exposes no agent-host bridge, so an owned session has no native chat editor there. This flow accepts the desktop work that does not depend on it; native clicked controls are accepted on the bridged route in native-controls-*.json.
